text: sed -n '35,70p' src/codegen_support/runtime/io/fread.rs: e the backend descriptor -- emitter.instruction("str x0, [sp, #0]"); // save the opaque stream handle emitter.instruction("str x1, [sp, #8]"); // save requested read length // A FAILED read and a legitimate zero-byte read both end with length 0, so length alone // cannot tell PHP's `false` from its `""`. Slot 40 carries that distinction and leaves in // x0, beside the x1/x2 string pair. emitter.instruction("mov x9, #1"); emitter.instruction("str x9, [sp, #40]"); // "this is a real result" — cleared only by an actual read failure emitter.instruction("bl __rt_stream_fd"); // resolve the backend descriptor through StreamState emitter.instruction("str x0, [sp, #32]"); // preserve the resolved backend descriptor emitter.instruction("mov w9, #0x4000"); // load the high half of USER_WRAPPER_FD_BASE = 0x40000000 emitter.instruction("lsl w9, w9, #16"); // shift into bits 30..16 to form 0x40000000
